trajectory.text:
Here's the current shelf status and this week's waste summary:

## On-Shelf Inventory (last counted 9/4/26)

| Item | On Hand | Expiring Soon |
|---|---|---|
| Chicken thighs | 42 kg | 6 kg |
| Beef patties (150g) | 190 ea | 0 |
| Brioche buns | 180 ea | 24 ea |
| Fries (2.5kg bags) | 40 kg | 0 |
| Iceberg lettuce | 9 heads | 4 heads |
| Tomatoes | 7 kg | 3 kg |
| Cheddar slices | 320 ea | 0 |
| Cola syrup (BIB) | 30 L | 0 |
| Fryer oil | 25 L | 0 |
| Fry boxes | 600 ea | 0 |

⚠️ **Watch items:** Lettuce and tomatoes are low on-hand *and* have a chunk expiring — worth using soon or reordering.

## This Week's Waste — Total: **$74.97**

| Item | Qty Wasted | Cost |
|---|---|---|
| Chicken thighs | 6 kg | $40.80 |
| Brioche buns | 24 ea | $9.50 |
| Fries | 5 kg | $8.40 |
| Beef patties | 6 ea | $7.20 |
| Lettuce | 4 heads | $4.67 |
| Tomatoes | 2 kg | $4.40 |
| Cheese/Cola/Oil/Boxes | 0 | $0.00 |

**By reason:**
- Expired: $44.60 (top reason — mostly chicken)
- Overproduction: $15.60
- Prep waste: $13.60
- Dropped: $1.17

Chicken thighs are the biggest waste driver, almost entirely from expiration — that's a good candidate to investigate (rotation, order quantity, or par level). Want me to log a new waste entry, record a fresh count, or dig into a specific item?
